_comment_DEP_001: RESOLVED: contracts was a `*` dependency, which resolves off the `latest` dist-tag (stuck at 0.2.0-alpha.54) for anyone installing the published tarball — stale legal-doc text and a stale clinic address. Decision: contracts is a PEER dependency (plus a devDependency for local build/typecheck), because auth-client re-exports contracts values (AudienceSchema, AUDIENCES, validateAudience) and parses with AccessTokenClaimsSchema; a normal dependency would let npm install a second nested copy alongside the consumer's own pin. Floor 0.2.0-alpha.85 is the oldest contracts version any current auth-client consumer installs (hollis-health-app/server); ceiling <0.3.0 because the audience/claims contract is 0.2.x. Reviewed: 2026-09-20
